{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Clean revenue — remove commas and convert to float
# First, check if any revenue has commas
print("Revenue with commas:")
print(df[df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)]['revenue'].head())

# Yes — one has comma: '999,999.99'
# Remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Step 2: Filter out QA orders (999999.99) and refunded orders
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Keep only completed, non-QA orders
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask]

# Step 3: Filter for LOYAL customers
loyal_df = filtered_df[filtered_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Step 4: Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_df['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Step 5: Check number of LOYAL orders
num_loyal = len(loyal_df)

# Output
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders (non-QA): {num_loyal}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}")

mean_revenue"}
